title: e-Shram registration and UAN card
summary: e-Shram is the national database of unorganised workers, including gig and platform workers. Registration is free and gives a 12-digit UAN card. It is the gateway to many central benefits.
eligibility: Age 16 to 59
Not a member of EPFO or ESIC
Not an income tax payer
Gig and platform workers are covered
benefits: UAN card that identifies you as a registered worker
Access to central and state schemes for registered workers
how_to_apply: Go to the e-Shram portal or the Common Service Centre (CSC) near you. Registration is free
Use the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar
Keep your bank account details ready
Download or collect your UAN card
status_note: A Ministry of Labour circular dated 1 June 2026 reportedly required online aggregators to onboard and integrate with e-Shram by 21 June 2026. How many platforms have done this is not confirmed. Workers can and should register themselves directly.

title: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) pension
summary: A voluntary pension scheme for unorganised workers. You pay a small monthly amount and the government adds an equal amount. After age 60 you get a fixed monthly pension.
eligibility: Age 18 to 40
Monthly income of Rs 15,000 or less
Not a member of EPFO, ESIC or NPS
Not an income tax payer
benefits: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60
how_to_apply: Visit a Common Service Centre (CSC)
Carry your Aadhaar and bank account (savings or Jan Dhan) details
Contribution is auto-debited from your bank account every month
documents_needed: Savings or Jan Dhan bank account with IFSC
status_note: Monthly contribution depends on your age when you join. Confirm the current amount on the official portal.

title: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) accident insurance
summary: Very low-cost accident insurance. About Rs 20 a year is auto-debited from your bank account. It pays your family if you die in an accident, and pays you if you are disabled by one.
eligibility: Age 18 to 70
Have a bank account with auto-debit consent
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full disability
how_to_apply: Ask your bank branch, net banking or app for PMSBY
Give consent for yearly auto-debit
Keep the policy confirmation message
status_note: Premium and cover amounts can change. Confirm current figures with your bank.

title: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) life insurance
summary: Low-cost life insurance renewed every year. If the insured person dies for any reason, the family gets a fixed amount.
eligibility: Age 18 to 50
Have a bank account with auto-debit consent
benefits: Rs 2 lakh to the family on death from any cause
how_to_apply: Ask your bank branch or banking app for PMJJBY
Give consent for yearly auto-debit
status_note: Yearly premium is about Rs 436 as last known. Confirm the current figure with your bank.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health cover
summary: Government health insurance that pays for hospital treatment at listed hospitals. Families who qualify can get cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year.
eligibility: Depends on state and household lists. Check with the helpline or the nearest Ayushman Mitra at a hospital
benefits: Cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at listed hospitals
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or call 14555
Go to a CSC or listed hospital with Aadhaar and ration card
Get your Ayushman card made
status_note: Eligibility is decided by household lists, not by being a gig worker. See scheme.pmjay_gig for the separate gig-worker announcement.

title: PM-JAY health cover for platform and gig workers
summary: The Union Budget 2025-26 announced registration of online platform workers on e-Shram, ID cards, and health cover under PM-JAY for them. Whether enrolment is actually open to every gig worker is not confirmed.
eligibility: Platform or gig worker registered on e-Shram
Final rules depend on the scheme notification
benefits: Health cover announced as up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year, under PM-JAY
how_to_apply: Register on e-Shram first
Watch the e-Shram portal and call 14434 to ask whether enrolment has opened for gig workers
status_note: Announced in the Union Budget 2025-26. We could not confirm that enrolment is fully operating. Do not tell a worker they already have this cover. Tell them to register on e-Shram and ask 14434.

title: One Nation One Ration Card
summary: If you have a ration card, you can collect your subsidised grain from any ration shop in India. This helps migrant workers who work away from home.
eligibility: Hold a valid ration card linked with Aadhaar
benefits: Collect your ration from any fair price shop in the country
how_to_apply: Make sure your ration card is linked with Aadhaar
Go to any ration shop and verify with biometric authentication

title: PM SVANidhi loan for street vendors
summary: A collateral-free working-capital loan for street vendors, with a discount for repaying on time and using digital payments. Loan limits have been revised, so confirm the current amount.
eligibility: Street vendor with a certificate of vending or a letter of recommendation from the local body
benefits: Interest benefit for timely repayment and digital payments
how_to_apply: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or at a CSC
Take your vending certificate or recommendation letter and Aadhaar
documents_needed: Vending certificate or local body recommendation
status_note: Loan amounts and conditions were revised. Confirm current limits on the portal before quoting a figure.

title: Construction worker welfare board registration (BOCW)
summary: Construction workers can register with their state's Building and Other Construction Workers welfare board. Registered workers can get benefits such as accident cover, education help for children and maternity support. Each state has its own rules.
eligibility: Usually age 18 to 60
Usually worked a minimum number of days in construction in the last year (often 90). Check your state
benefits: State welfare board benefits. These vary by state and may include accident, health, education and maternity help
how_to_apply: Ask your state labour department or welfare board office
Carry a work certificate from a contractor or a union letter, plus Aadhaar and bank details
status_note: Rules and benefits differ by state, and labour law is being reorganised under the new labour codes. Confirm with the state labour department.

title: Jan Dhan bank account
summary: A basic bank account that can be opened with zero balance. It is the account you need for PMSBY, PMJJBY, PM-SYM and for getting benefits directly in your account.
eligibility: Any Indian resident without a basic bank account
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or bank mitra with your Aadhaar
